speaker: john_heminges
text: The boxes are here, and I am not going to give this week a name it has not earned in the book. Last Saturday was thirty shillings. It was the best since Christmas. Last Saturday can have its praise without this Saturday borrowing it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not ask you for a figure you have just refused. Thirty was last week. I have spent the week, and I have not spent it in order to round it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: My stair was honest. Thursday's house and Monday's house were not the same size, and I said so on Monday, two-thirds and louder, and I am not turning two-thirds into a purse to help a parlour feel finished.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then let the parlour feel unfinished. Kemp's interest stands where I left it. Twenty-four lines. Eleven on the Thursday, thirteen on the Monday. Nothing added since. No song. I will not grow a tally because a week is ending and men like a ribbon on it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Twenty-four lines, and you may say them once, and then you may sit down. They laughed at my lines, Will. I counted them on the day, and I am not counting them again for an audience of sharers. You keep to you. A song would have been a different brag, and I have not made it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You, then. And no song. Twenty-four is the margin. It is not a share, and I will not let a clever mouth marry the two because both numbers have a two and a four in them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nor will I. Edith's eight shillings lies where it lay last week, under the candlestick, and this sitting does not pay it. The stock owes it. Tonight does not. The mercer's fifty for the watchet is the same story in a dearer cloth. Unpaid. Not vanished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Unpaid, and not vanished. I am not paying either of them out of a figure we have not got. The Queen's twenty pounds is not in this room. I would have noticed twenty pounds. They are heavier than a mood.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Heavier than my box, too. I have pennies and halfpence and a patience, and I am not dressing them as a share. If Heminges will not name one, I will not invent one on the stair and call it loyalty.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Monday's bill, since we are setting paper and not poetry. The Two Gentlemen of Verona, at two of the clock. That is the afternoon. I am not giving you the plot of it, and I am not giving Kemp a fresh column in advance of a yard.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Two gentlemen. I can bear two gentlemen if they do not ask me for a song in the first hour. You may write the bill. You may not write my interest as a hope.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The bill is set. Shrove Tuesday is the comedy again, and it is not today, and it is not a number I am entering beside a hope. This is the last Saturday of this reckoning until the house is somewhere else. Lent can have the dark weeks without a pretended total to warm them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The last of these Saturdays, then, and no pretended total. I played Egeon. I opened, and I waited, and I came to the end. That is a true sentence, and it is not a receipt.

speaker: margery_pell
text: True sentences are cheap. Boxes are particular. Take your particular home unclassified, Master Shakespeare, and do not let the road add a shilling a pace.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Twenty-four lines. I have said it. If anyone says eleven, he is a week behind. If anyone says a song, he is a week ahead. I live in this week. It is quite enough.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Enough is what a clown hates, and what a reckoning loves. I will take enough. I will not take a speech about how quiet I was. Quiet was a choice on a shipwreck. The shipwreck was yours, Will. You are welcome to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am welcome to Egeon, and I am welcome to no sum. Dick is not here to be thanked, and his father is not here to be priced. Two mornings in March are still two mornings. They are not a line in this book.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then they are not a line in this book. I will close it on what I will not write, which is a figure for a week that the boxes have not yet taught me. You may all go home poorer in certainty and no poorer in fact. That is the best honesty I have at this hour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will go home with the certainty I came with. Last week, thirty. This week, unnamed. Edith, eight, unpaid. The gown, fifty, unpaid. The Queen, twenty pounds, not had. Kemp, twenty-four lines, and no song. I can say that list without pretending it is a balance.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Say it on the stair if you must say it. Do not say it to my box. My box has been counted, and it did not ask to be a proverb.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The pin goes in the cork. Monday, two gentlemen, two of the clock. I am finished. Anyone who adds a column after I stand up can keep it in his own hand, and explain it without me.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Stand up, then. I am for a supper that does not have a margin. You, Will. Not a word about a song between here and Bishopsgate, or I will give you one out of spite, and Garnish will have to come back for his pin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not a word about a song. Not a figure, either. John, I heard you. I will not help the week to a name on the way home.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we are done. The book is shut on a blank I am willing to own. That is rarer than a total, and I do not need it admired.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Rarer, and lighter to carry than a wrong sum. I am for the stair. My box is shut. Do not open it again with a better story.
